# Every test file under .github/scripts, fork-ci and fork-kit (*.test.*, subdirectories included) and
# where it runs (.github/scripts/fork-ci-tests.cjs checks this list).
#   <test>                  run by Fork tests (fork-kit/ in the kit job, fork-ci/ and the
#                           fleet walls' in the action job, the rest in the workflows job),
#                           by extension (sh, py, cjs, mjs, js)
#   <test> ~<seconds>s      the same, with its usual time on CI: the longest start first.
#                           Tests without one start before them. A test over 30 s without
#                           one, or far from its weight, gets a note in the log to fix it.
#   <test> run by <file>    run by <file>, which must name the test's path (not one
#                           of upstream's workflows: they are disabled in the fork)
# A present test that is not listed fails. A listed file that is not present yet
# is a note; one that was present and then deleted fails.
